# Meredith Baker

> Leadership coach and keynote speaker in Los Angeles. Helps leaders connect to themselves so they can inspire others, on self-trust, inner confidence and authentic connection. Master Certified Life Coach accredited through the ICF, NLP practitioner, certified breathwork facilitator and 500-hour yoga and meditation instructor, with more than 10,000 coaching hours. Studied at Harvard College and the University of Oxford (MSc). Ironman finisher, 25+ marathons, 54 countries.

## Work
- Meredith Baker Coaching: executive coaching and team facilitation (since 2020)
- More Of That: co-founder, connective experiences for thousands of people in Los Angeles and San Francisco (since 2020)
- Formats: keynotes, leadership workshops, team experiences, executive coaching
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese
